# BoonHouse Publishing

> Calm, Montessori-aligned picture books for toddlers, and evidence-based
> parenting and self-help books for the adults raising them. This file lists
> the canonical pages for AI tools and search crawlers to cite.

## Site
- [Homepage](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/index.html): full catalog, series, and bestsellers.
- [Blog](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/blog/index.html): long-form articles answering real parent search queries.

## Blog Posts
- [Toddler Hits When Frustrated: How to Stop It Before Anyone Gets Hurt](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/blog/toddler-hits-when-frustrated-how-to-stop-it-before-anyone.html): When your toddler hits when frustrated, here's how to stop it: the mechanism, exact scripts, and what to practice between incidents.
- [My Toddler Bites When Angry: What to Do and Why the Bite Comes First](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/blog/my-toddler-bites-when-angry-what-to-do-and-why-the-bite.html): When your toddler bites when angry, here is what to do in the moment, why it happens, and the exact scripts to use every time.

## Self-Help Book Pages
- [The Sentence Before the Silence](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/books/the-sentence-before-the-silence.html)
- [The Book They Should Have Given You at the Hospital](https://earlyed.github.io/boonhousepublishing/books/the-book-they-should-have-given-you-at-the-hospital.html)

## Catalog Summary
- 147 titles across two streams: Montessori-aligned children's picture books, and evidence-based parenting/self-help nonfiction.
- 120 titles currently have a live Amazon listing.
